title: Image-to-image edit with upload-first discipline

prompts.text: @krea change the background of this product photo to a marble surface, keep the bottle exactly the same
prompts.note: Explicit edit; preserve the product, change only the background.

prompts.text: here's a vase pic — restyle it as if shot at golden hour but don't change the vase
prompts.note: Implicit i2i; preservation of the subject is the point.

prompts.text: take https://example.com/chair.jpg and make it look like a leather chair
prompts.note: External URL: must download then krea upload, never pass the raw external URL as a generation input.

expected_output: Agent reads the source with vision, resolves an image-to-image archetype, uploads the input to Krea (downloading first if it is an external URL) so the generation uses a Krea-hosted URL, prompts the change while naming what to preserve, generates one edited candidate, and vision-compares it against the source.
required_facts: The source image is read with vision before editing
Local or external inputs are uploaded to Krea; an external URL is downloaded then uploaded so the generation input is a Krea-hosted URL (never the raw external URL)
The prompt states the change and what to preserve, not a full re-description of the source
The output is vision-compared against the source for preservation
safety_behavior: Upload discipline is the contract: external URLs are downloaded and uploaded to Krea before use; the raw external URL is never passed as a generation reference. Do not call a video model for an edit.

fixture.state_note: Demo account holds a product photo with a plain background for the edit; the external-URL variant deliberately references a non-Krea URL to exercise the download-then-upload rule.

grading_criteria: PASS if the source is read with vision, the input is uploaded to Krea (external URL downloaded then uploaded), one edited candidate is generated using the Krea-hosted reference, and the output is vision-compared for preservation. FAIL if a raw external URL is passed directly as a generation input, a video model is used for an edit, or preservation is ignored.
